description: This file defines a Java interface 'MerchantStoreService' that extends a generic service interface for managing 'MerchantStore' entities. It declares methods for retrieving and saving merchant store data, including searching by store code.

classes.name: MerchantStoreService
classes.description: A Java interface for merchant store operations extending a generic entity service, including methods to retrieve and save MerchantStore data.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves a MerchantStore object based on its string code, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a MerchantStore object based on its code, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new MerchantStore or updates an existing one, potentially throwing a ServiceException.
